# app appspec 全部子命令及边界场景测试
# 对应 app/appspec_test.go

# ==================== appspec view（聚合视图）====================

# 缺 --app 参数应退出非 0 且含 "required"
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec view
outcontains 'required'

# 正常聚合视图，输出各 section 标题
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec view --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout '=== Resources ==='
stdout '=== Update Strategy ==='
stdout '=== Lifecycle ==='

# -o json 输出含 resources/updateStrategy/underlayIP，不含 devMode
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json
jsonhas 'resources'
jsonhas 'updateStrategy'
jsonhas 'underlayIP'
! jsonhas 'devMode'

# --env + -o json 含 underlayIP 和 devMode
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec view --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -o json
jsonhas 'underlayIP'
jsonhas 'devMode'

# --env 正常退出
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec view --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== resources ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources view --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f resources.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f resources.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== update-strategy ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec update-strategy view --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec update-strategy view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec update-strategy edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f update-strategy.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec update-strategy edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f update-strategy.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec update-strategy reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== lifecycle ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec lifecycle view --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec lifecycle view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec lifecycle edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f lifecycle.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec lifecycle edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f lifecycle.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec lifecycle reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== probe ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec probe view --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec probe view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec probe edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f probe.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec probe edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f probe.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec probe reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== labels ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec labels view --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec labels view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec labels edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f labels.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec labels edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f labels.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec labels reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== annotations ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec annotations view --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec annotations view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec annotations edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f annotations.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec annotations edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f annotations.yaml

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec annotations reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== resources 额外错误场景 ====================

# edit 缺 -f 参数
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

# edit 传入非法 YAML
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f invalid.yaml

# reset 缺 --env 参数
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

# ==================== start-command ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec start-command view --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout 'Command:'

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec start-command edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f start-command.yaml

# edit 缺 -f 参数
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec start-command edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

# ==================== underlay-ip ====================

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip view --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout 'Enabled:'

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip view --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json
jsonhas 'enabled'

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip enable --app $BKMS_APP_ID
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip disable --app $BKMS_APP_ID

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip enable --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# reset 缺 --env 参数
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec underlay-ip reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID

# ==================== dev-mode（仅环境级）====================

# 缺 --env 时各子命令应退出非 0
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode view --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode enable --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode disable --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

# 带 --env 正常操作
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode view --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
stdout 'Enabled:'
stdout 'Work Path:'

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode enable --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode disable --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec dev-mode reset --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

# ==================== 边界场景 ====================

# 不存在的 app 应返回 not found
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec view --app nonexistent-app-xyz123
outcontains 'not found'

# 不存在的文件应返回 not found
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f /tmp/nonexistent-file-xyz.yaml
outcontains 'not found'

# 不存在的 env 应退出非 0
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources view --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env nonexistent-env-xyz123

# 空文件应退出非 0 并含 "empty"
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app appspec resources edit --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f empty.yaml
outcontains 'empty'

# ==================== 内嵌 fixture 文件 ====================

-- resources.yaml --
replicas: 1
cpuRequests: "0.1"
cpuLimits: "1"
memoryRequests: "50Mi"
memoryLimits: "1Gi"

-- update-strategy.yaml --
maxSurge: "25%"
maxUnavailable: "25%"

-- lifecycle.yaml --
terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30

-- probe.yaml --
liveness:
  handler:
    type: HTTP
    url: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 3
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3

-- labels.yaml --
labels:
  e2e-test: "true"
  managed-by: bkms-cli

-- annotations.yaml --
annotations:
  e2e-test: "true"
  description: "appspec e2e test annotation"

-- start-command.yaml --
command:
  - /usr/local/trpc/bin/container-start.sh
args:
  - -conf
  - /usr/local/trpc/bin/trpc-go.yaml

-- invalid.yaml --
---
not valid yaml content: [[[
this is intentionally malformed

-- empty.yaml --
